### How the entry was generated

Paste the command you ran (see [docs/publishing-mods.md](../../docs/publishing-mods.md)):

```
corepack pnpm catalog-entry -- --file <file> --url <https-url> --id <slug> ... --verify
```

- [ ] I ran the script with `--verify` and it passed.
- [ ] I added the printed entry to `catalog/catalog.json`.
